components.name: Launch Control Unit (LCU)
components.reasoning: The LCU acts as a command center for the operator, controlling the missile's launch sequence and providing feedback on targeting data. It is a major subassembly with its own supply chain for customization and compatibility reasons.

components.name: Electrical Harnesses and Cables
components.reasoning: These provide power and communication interfaces between components of the Javelin system, essential for functional operation but not integrated into larger assemblies without distinct procurement.

components.name: Explosive Device Controller (EDC)
components.reasoning: This subassembly manages the arming process of the warhead based on ECU inputs and launch conditions. Its separate production ensures specialized integration and reliability assurance.

components.name: Control Actuators
components.reasoning: These move the guidance fins to stabilize the missile during flight and ensure it stays on target. As a distinct assembly, they are tailored for specific performance characteristics.

components.name: Fins and Trajectory Deflection System (TDS)
components.reasoning: The fins provide lift necessary for stable flight while TDS allows in-flight adjustments to correct trajectory deviations during engagement phases of the mission. Both elements have separate supply chains.
